topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't believe this. All these years, all the laughs, the secrets, the way we promised to be friends forever, and they just... don't remember any of it? How do you just forget someone who was so much a part of your life? I feel like I've been holding onto these memories, cherishing them, and to them, it's like they never even happened. It's like, what did I mean to them if it's all just gone? I can't even talk to them about it; what am I supposed to say? "Hey, remember when we were inseparable?" But they won’t, and that's the worst part.
